notes: The hyphenation artifact "pro-ject" is read as project, which is the prescribed handling of defective text; the noun-complement infinitive is carried as the entity-attached (To sk_plan_1 sk_expand_1) with the expand event reified but left tenseless and unasserted, and the past perfect takes Past with no Before since no other asserted event is present. (Possession sk_impact_1 sk_project_1) is the same borderline event-noun-subject genitive as elsewhere in this family.
